new_value:
Implemented docs/design/frontend-auth.md §4.6 for IRC, the only front end it applies to today. New crates/mimid-agent/src/tailnet.rs: the LocalAPI whois/status client over the existing tls::localapi_get, [tailnet] identity/owners/nodes/tags/socket/recheck_s, and the matching rules with all three exclusions (tagged nodes, the agent's own node, nodes that advertise routes). The rules stay in mimid-agent; mimid-agent-irc gets a new PeerIdentity trait and only asks, so it still checks no secret of its own (AGENTS.md crate map). A matched node registers with no credential, is not offered soju.im/account-required in CAP LS nor draft/ACCOUNTREQUIRED in ISUPPORT, and any PASS or SASL PLAIN it sends succeeds (903/900) without becoming the thing that authorized it; Session::by_tailnet tells the two apart, so a credential session still lives by §3.7 while a node session closes when the node stops matching. /msg mimid tailnet reports what matched. JMAP deliberately unchanged (decision A7).

FAILS CLOSED: identity on with an unreachable tailscaled, a tagged own node with no owners, and a status with no node id all refuse to start, the last because the own-node exclusion is an id comparison. [tailnet] identity = true without [irc] is refused rather than silently doing nothing.

Tests: crates/mimid-agent/tests/tailnet.rs, 7 tests over a fake tailscaled on a Unix socket, so they stay offline.

LEFT OUT, filed as mimid-e13m.18: /msg mimid tailnet deny <node> with its persisted deny list (a new mimid-agent-store table), and the cross-session listing (mimid-agent-irc keeps no registry of open connections). §4.6 itself says the real revocation is removing the node in the admin console, which this honours within recheck_s. XMPP and Matrix mappings wait on those front ends.

All gates green except the known flake mimid-s6a3 (stock_rust_client, pre-existing, recurrence noted there).
